articles.summary: TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO; OTC: TOYWF) ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar solutions company, today announced that its Chief Strategy Officer, Rhone Resch, will present at the Jefferies Renewables, Clean Energy, Construction Conference, to be held in New York, NY on September 9–11, 2026. The Company will be available for 1×1 and small group meetings with institutional investors throughout the day. Fireside Chat details Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026 (in-person) Time: 11:00-11:40 AM Location: Jefferies Conference Center in New York (Brooklyn Bridge) Format: Fireside chat and 1×1 investor meetings Attendance: By invitation only. Institutional investors who would like to schedule a meeting with TOYO management should contact their Jefferies representative. About TOYO Co., Ltd. TOYO is a solar manufacturing company that is committed to becoming a vertically integrated solar manufacturer in the global market, integrating the upstream production of wafers
articles.title: TOYO Co., Ltd to Participate in Fireside Chat at the Jefferies Renewables, Clean Energy, & Construction Conference
